title: Vocational Rehabilitation Counseling/Counselor

knowledge_weighting.method: entry-weighted mean of O*NET 31.0 importance (Scale IM): entry targets weight 2; other linked occupations in Job Zone 4 or 5 (or the entry targets' Job Zone) weight 1; Manager, Chief, Postsecondary-faculty, All Other, Supervisor, Director and Treasurers and Controllers titles, and non-target occupations in other Job Zones, weight 0
knowledge_weighting.note: top_knowledge/top_skills are the unweighted mean over all linked occupations (kept for comparison); the outline uses the entry-weighted lists.

skipped_knowledge.reason: service and client-relations knowledge; the outline leaves it to internships, part-time work and the practice tasks rather than a course slot
office procedures and records handling; usually learned on the job, so it gets no course slot
teaching and training others is built through presenting, tutoring and peer teaching in projects rather than a dedicated course
management and planning knowledge matters most after several years of experience, so the outline gives it no course slot (a management elective is optional)

outline_elements.rule: English Language is placed in Year 1 general education; workplace and management elements (Customer and Personal Service, Administrative, Clerical, Administration and Management, Personnel and Human Resources, Education and Training) get no course slot unless the major's CIP series is about them; the next three elements go to Year 2 and up to three more (ordered by importance to the entry targets) to Year 3; if fewer than two remain for Year 3, knowledge rated at least 2.5 for the entry targets fills it

method.field_fit: field fit = cosine similarity between the CIP program title's field terms and the occupation's O*NET 31.0 text (title, description and all task statements). Words are Snowball-stemmed, generic words (science, studies, technology, engineering, management, education, general, other, ...) are ignored, and terms are weighted by log term frequency times inverse document frequency over all O*NET occupations. Compound title words are also split into the O*NET vocabulary stems of 5+ letters they contain (electromechanical -> electr, mechan; telecommunications -> commun), so a compound does not count as a mismatch. CIP definitions are not in the pinned crosswalk file, so the CIP title is the field description. A rule target is dropped as clearly implausible when (1) its fit is 0, meaning no field term of the program title occurs anywhere in its O*NET title, description or tasks; (2) some eligible linked occupation in the same Job Zone tier has fit >= 0.02, so the crosswalk does offer a field match; (3) it is an O*NET detailed specialty code (not .00), whose link is typically inherited from a broad SOC code such as Engineers, All Other; (4) its base .00 occupation also has fit 0; and (5) its fit with the titles of all CIP codes in the program's 4-digit CIP series (the field family) is below 0.12, so it is not a close neighbour of the field either (e.g. a genetics program keeps Molecular and Cellular Biologists). The thresholds were set by inspecting the candidate drops of this release; they are not validated. Dropped targets are replaced from the same ranked tier with the next occupations whose fit is above 0; if none remain, the plan keeps fewer targets. A base (.00) target with fit 0 is kept but flagged better_field_match_available when a non-target occupation in the same tier has fit >= 0.1
method.supervisory_tasks: task statement matches a supervisory/managerial pattern (supervise, provide supervision, direct and coordinate, direct the work/activities/staff of, manage staff/personnel/employees/workers/teams, oversee the work/staff, hire, subordinates, assign work to, evaluate the work/performance of, train and supervise); 'under supervision' does not count

notes.detail: no eligible Job Zone 4 occupation is linked, so the entry targets come from another Job Zone

quality_flags.retired_checks: v4 low_title_overlap (lexical title overlap) was retired in v5: it flagged 1,273 targets in 756 of 1,017 plans, mostly plausible pairs that use different words, and changed nothing

entry_target_basis: Job Zone 5 linked occupations (excluding Manager/Chief/Postsecondary/All Other/Supervisor/Director/Treasurers and Controllers titles), ranked by similarity of their O*NET knowledge-importance profile to the average profile of the eligible linked occupations (Pearson correlation), base O*NET-SOC .00 codes first; no eligible Job Zone 4 occupation is linked to this major, so Job Zone 5 was used
